answer: A Weekly community check-in streak over one year verified by signed timestamps forces the applicant to show up again and again: every week the applicant signs in, the signed timestamps go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so a Sybil farm must sustain every fake identity for months instead of minting them in an afternoon. A vault that appears twice is the tell: the same week cannot be attended twice. From the voyage to the ferrous, the same rule holds: no presence, no trust, no exception.
